plan.goal: Show Gajanan drinking at the cattle trough and Damodar returning with scented water to stop him.

turn.text: Gajanan drinks the muddy trough water and belches; Damodar arrives with a gadva of clear vetiver water.

assets.mid: well with a trough (haal) beside it; cattle drinking at the trough
assets.fg: thin foreground frame of grass blades

shots.action: camera dollies in on well and trough
shots.performance: cattle stand still drinking; water surface calm
staging: STAGING: hold on the trough water to show it is muddy (gaDhuuL)

assets.img: Gajanan standing at the trough, bent forward, hands cupped, drinking water; old torn bandi on near-naked body

shots.performance: held pose of drinking, head bent, hands at water
staging: STAGING: pose shows drinking action only; belch is separate beat

assets.img: Gajanan upright after drinking, head lifted, chest slightly expanded, one hand at throat, calm face; old torn bandi

shots.performance: held pose of post-drink belch (truptateche Dhekar)
staging: STAGING: chest expanded, hand at throat shows belch completed

assets.left: Gajanan upright, calm face, old torn bandi, facing right
assets.right: Damodarpant standing, holding brass gadva in both hands, concerned expression, facing left

shots.action: Damodar stands before Gajanan offering water
shots.performance: both figures still, facing each other; gadva held forward in Damodar's hands
staging: STAGING: brass gadva clearly visible in Damodar's hands

assets.face: Damodarpant close-up, eyebrows raised, mouth open in alarm, one hand pointing sideways toward trough

shots.camera: slow push in with breathing sway

dialogue.speaker: Damodarpant
dialogue.marathi: हां हां तें गढूळ पाणी । समर्था न लावा वदनीं । तें जनावरालागुनी । योग्य आहे प्यावया
dialogue.meaning_en: Oh oh, that muddy water. Samarth, do not put it to your mouth. It is fit for animals to drink.

staging: STAGING: eyes wide, hand pointing off-screen to trough

assets.insert: pair of hands holding brass gadva, clear water visible inside, a few vetiver roots (vaalaa) lying on the rim

shots.performance: hands steady, gadva tilted slightly to show water clarity and vetiver

dialogue.speaker: Damodarpant
dialogue.marathi: मीं हें पहा आणिलें नीर । गोड निर्मळ थंडगार । वासित केलें साचार । वाळा घालून यामध्यें

problems.problem: Shot S6-2 attempts to animate a head lift and throat movement (belch) within a single image, which is not possible with the 03_slow_cinematic_push preset.
problems.fix: Split the action into two separate shots: one for drinking, one for the belch, or use a static drinking pose only.

problems.problem: Shot S6-3 includes a gentle drift across both figures, but the 09_dialogue_composition preset is static and cannot show movement across the frame.
problems.fix: Remove the drift; use a cut between two static poses or replace the preset with one that supports camera movement.

problems.problem: The description specifies a stone well with a long stone trough and cows/buffaloes, none of which are mentioned in the ovi text.
problems.fix: Use a generic well and trough without specifying material or length, and describe the animals generically as cattle.

problems.problem: The performance 'held pose of drinking, then head lifted, throat moving' and the staging 'after drink, hold pose with chest slightly expanded for belch' require a pose change and throat movement inside one preset 03 shot, which is a single image with no limb or facial animation.
problems.fix: Split into two shots with two images (drinking pose, then a separate head-lifted post-drink/belch pose), or keep only the single drinking held pose and drop the in-shot change.

problems.problem: The performance 'Damodar steps forward, arms extended offering' (with the asset described as 'walking up') requires walking and arm movement inside preset 09, which only drifts across two static facing poses with no limb animation.
problems.fix: Use a static arrived pose of Damodar standing facing Gajanan holding the gadva in both hands, and let the camera drift or a separate entrance image carry the approach.

problems.shot_id: S6-3 (also S6-5, images S6_Damodar_arriving_gadva and S6_gadva_hands_vetiver)
problems.problem: The plan specifies a clay/earthen gadva, but the owner's frozen research records 'video prop choice: brass' for Damodar's gadva at ovi 135.
problems.fix: Change all gadva depictions to brass, or have the owner re-freeze the prop choice before the images are made.
